description: This file defines the WaveState class which manages signal wave states, including handling trigger signals, storing up/down transitions, and computing maximum times for engine reports.

classes.name: WaveState
classes.description: Manages waveform state for engine triggers, handling signal transitions, and producing a list of UpDown events.

classes.name: WaveState.trigger_value_e
classes.description: Enumeration of trigger signal states: LOW and HIGH.

methods.name: handle
methods.description: Processes a signal change (up or down) at a given angle, updating internal state and list of engine report events.

methods.name: wrap
methods.description: Finalizes wave data, adding a concluding UpDown event if a down signal was pending.

methods.name: getMaxTime
methods.description: Returns the maximum time value from the list of UpDown events.
